subject: Commercial options & security gating — next steps (Novexa)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Commercial options & security gating — next steps (Novexa)

Thanks again for taking the call today, Samantha — good discussion. Quick post-call recap and concrete next steps so we stay aligned on procurement readiness and security gating.

Recap (what we covered)
- Use cases: inference for summarization + reranking; expected avg throughput ~150k tokens/day, bursty during batch imports.
- Commercial paths: 1) short pilot on credit card (fastest), 2) PO + SOW for enterprise procurement, 3) AWS Marketplace (if you want centralized billing and faster vendor onboarding).
- Security gating: you mentioned SOC 2 Type II evidence, a mutual DPA, and completion of Novexa's vendor security questionnaire before legal signs PO/SOW.

Asks / next steps
1) Please confirm preferred procurement route (Card pilot | PO w/ SOW | Marketplace). If PO, confirm whether legal will do redlines or if you want us to propose a one-page amendment.
2) I attached a concise SOC2 summary and the SOW draft we discussed — can you loop in procurement/legal and confirm the primary contact?
3) If you share your security questionnaire, Marissa/Ben and I will map items to our SOC2/DPA artifacts and call out any open evidence requests.

Attachments: SOW_Draft_Novexa_v1.pdf (draft), SOC2-summary-2025.pdf (artifact summary)

Proposed timeline (to keep this moving)
- Today: confirm preferred procurement path and primary procurement/legal contacts
- +3 business days: Redwood to return any requested artifacts and a PO-ready SOW (if PO route)
- +7–14 business days: Procurement/legal review and signature (typical — varies by organization)

I can also schedule a quick 30-min alignment with your procurement/legal team if that helps accelerate the PO route.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novexa.com>

Cc: procurement@novexa.com
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial options & security gating — next steps (Novexa)

Thanks Jordan — great summary. A couple items from our side:

Preferred commercial path
- Our procurement team prefers PO + SOW for anything over $15k ARR. We can run a short credit card pilot for evaluation, but the target for production will be PO. If Marketplace pricing is strictly the same and Marketplace allows faster procurement (our procurement can consume via marketplace contracts), we'll consider that too.

Security gating
- Legal will need SOC 2 Type II evidence (summary + auditor report) and our standard DPA. I'm attaching our vendor onboarding checklist and security questionnaire — we typically require completion of the questionnaire before legal will sign.
- Procurement cycle here is ~3–4 weeks once we have the SOW + SOC2 artifacts; legal redlines usually come back in the first week.

Next steps from Novexa
- I'm looping procurement (procurement@novexa.com) — they will own PO paperwork.
- I'll ask legal to begin an initial review once we have the SOW + SOC2 summary.

Attachments: Novexa_Vendor_Onboarding.pdf, Novexa_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

Samantha Lee
Head of Data & ML Partnerships
Novexa Health
samantha.lee@novexa.com

- Jordan: please confirm which SOC2 artifacts we can share now (summary + auditor report or redacted report). Also confirm whether we should propose our standard DPA or send a blank DPA template for their counsel.

Attachments to send to Novexa when ready: SOC2-summary-2025.pdf, DPA-template.docx, SOW_PoReady_Novexa_v1.pdf (once Ben completes).

Notes on marketplace: If procurement can accept AWS Marketplace, that can reduce procurement friction (they consume from their marketplace contract) — but only if pricing/commitments align. Let's not lead with Marketplace until we have PO fallback in progress.
